name: Sandhill Crane
description: The Sandhill Crane is a tall bird with long legs, a slender neck, and a distinctive red forehead in adults. Its gray plumage can take on rusty tones from staining. Cranes use wetlands and open landscapes, where their upright silhouettes are easy to recognize. Courtship brings energetic dances with leaps, wing movements, and calls. In flight, the neck extends straight ahead, offering a useful distinction from herons. Watching a pair reveals both their deliberate walking pace and expressive movements.
